name: TP53_loss
summary: Focal TP53 deletion: partial or complete loss of the gene beyond the 17p arm level (measured relative to 17p_loss by the background rule).

name: PRDM1_loss
summary: Focal PRDM1 deletion: partial or complete loss of the gene beyond the 6q arm level (measured relative to 6q_loss by the background rule).

name: TOX_loss
summary: Partial or complete TOX deletion, measured against the genome baseline (no 8q arm feature). Catches deletions within TOX that are too small for the 8q12.1_loss peak (min_fraction 0.2 of 1.59 Mb); overlaps with that feature.

name: B2M_loss
summary: Partial or complete B2M deletion, measured against the genome baseline (no 15q arm feature, so arm-level and focal losses both count). B2M lies 883 kb outside the DLBClass 15q15.3_loss peak; overlaps with that feature.

name: 1p_loss
citation: GISTIC arm boundary from DLBCL_broad_significance.18Aug2024 (1p not significant in DLBClass)
summary: With background = auto it makes the four 1p focal losses (1p36.32, 1p36.11, 1p31.1, 1p13.1) relative to 1p in the curated set (not in the DLBClass set).
